claim_limit: All scores in this report are method-selection evidence from 2024, not an independent audit or confirmation. BTS schedules are retrospective proxies for D-24 schedule snapshots.

confirmation_gate.rule: No 2026 outcome may be acquired, loaded, tuned, or scored.

diagnostic_weather_severity.formula: max(log1p(endpoint convection)/5, endpoint icing, endpoint gust-crosswind knots/30, endpoint visibility category/3)
